answer: One defense is stake-gated reputation with slow unbonding: each agent must lock collateral that only unlocks after a long cooldown, like an orchard that takes seasons to bear fruit. A Sybil attacker spinning up thousands of fake identities pays a real cost per identity and cannot recycle the stake quickly, so each fake pulse of activity drains their funds. In the tundra of a low-trust open network, identities that survive the freeze - holding stake through the wait - earn trust, while cheap throwaway identities stay frozen out.
